<execute-bead>
  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260512T012520-91700fb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260512T012520-91700fb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260512T012520-91700fb6/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260512T012520-91700fb6/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260512T012520-91700fb6/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-e80c156e">
    <title>Provider introspection adapters: read /props at construction and merge into ProtocolCapabilities</title>
    <description>
P1 refinement on top of the dialect-fix bead fizeau-073fe18b.
Introspection adapters read provider /props at construction time and
override the static ThinkingFormat default with what the live server
actually claims.

Per ADR-010 Amendment 2026-05-11 the L1 layer (live introspection) is the
authoritative source where available; this bead implements L1 for ds4 and
llama-server. The static defaults that fizeau-073fe18b sets become the L3
floor; L2 (catalog reasoning_wire) sits in between.

After this bead lands, fizeau auto-detects:
- ds4's alias map → effective reasoning_levels without catalog curation
- llama-server's chat_template variant → auto-detect kwargs vs top-level
  envelope (today's wire choice is hardcoded by fizeau-073fe18b)
- server-side reasoning_format default → can override per-request only
  when needed

Cost model (measured 2026-05-11):
  ds4 /props on LAN:         p50=13ms  max=51ms  (n=10)
  sindri /props on LAN:      p50=9ms   max=13ms  (n=10)
  OR /api/v1/models cloud:   p50=316ms max=325ms (n=5)

Three adapters in this bead:

1. **ds4 adapter** (internal/provider/ds4/introspection.go, new):
   GET http://<base>/props. Parse reasoning.{supported_efforts, aliases,
   default, effective_default, think_max_min_context},
   api.supported_request_parameters, sampling, runtime. Derive effective
   ThinkingFormat=OpenAIEffort and effective reasoning_levels from
   supported_efforts minus aliased duplicates.

2. **llama-server adapter** (internal/provider/llamaserver/introspection.go,
   new): GET http://<base>/props. Parse
   default_generation_settings.params.reasoning_format, chat_template
   (substring match for `enable_thinking` to detect kwargs envelope),
   chat_template_caps.supports_preserve_reasoning, build_info.

3. **Common plumbing** (internal/provider/registry/introspection.go, new):
   ProviderIntrospection struct, registry of adapters by provider type,
   cache by (base_url, model), non-fatal failure with structured warning.

Construction order: instantiate provider → run introspection adapter (if
registered) → merge into capabilities → ready. Per-request path is
unchanged; no introspection IO at request time.

In-scope files:
- internal/provider/ds4/introspection.go (new)
- internal/provider/ds4/introspection_test.go (new)
- internal/provider/llamaserver/introspection.go (new)
- internal/provider/llamaserver/introspection_test.go (new)
- internal/provider/registry/introspection.go (new)
- internal/provider/registry/registry.go (wire adapter invocation)
- internal/provider/ds4/ds4.go (consume introspection)
- internal/provider/llamaserver/llamaserver.go (consume introspection)
- internal/provider/ds4/testdata/props/ (recorded fixtures)
- internal/provider/llamaserver/testdata/props/ (recorded fixtures)

Out-of-scope (separate beads):
- OR adapter (introspection thin; catalog L2 covers it).
- Anthropic-native / OpenAI-native adapters.
- vLLM adapter (defer until lane re-added).

Depends on: fizeau-073fe18b (wire-format dialect fixes — adapters set
the EFFECTIVE ThinkingFormat to the new variants).
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. `go test ./internal/provider/ds4/...` passes including a new test
   that parses a recorded /props fixture and asserts:
   - EffectiveReasoningLevels == [\"high\", \"max\"]
   - AliasMap reflects {low→high, medium→high, xhigh→high}
   - ThinkingFormat == OpenAIEffort
   - SupportedRequestParams contains \"reasoning_effort\"
2. `go test ./internal/provider/llamaserver/...` passes including a new
   test that parses a recorded /props fixture and asserts:
   - ThinkingFormat == Qwen (with chat_template_kwargs envelope after
     fizeau-073fe18b)
   - ServerSideReasoningFormat reflects the value in the fixture
3. `go test ./internal/provider/registry/...` passes including:
   - Adapter failure does not fail provider construction.
   - Cache hit: two providers at the same (base_url, model) trigger
     exactly one introspection call.
4. `go vet ./...` passes.
5. Manual smoke: operator script constructs ds4 + llama-server providers
   against live endpoints and prints the effective capabilities. Output
   includes the alias map, supported params, server-side reasoning_format.
    </acceptance>
